resources.string: Wrong PIN. One attempt left — after it the data will be erased
One attempt left — after it the data will be erased
Too many attempts. Try again in %1$s
Biometric unlock is off: the fingerprints on this device have changed. Enter your PIN and turn it on again in the settings.

To reset the PIN, the data on this device will be erased and you will be signed out. Your data will be downloaded from the server after you sign in again. Changes that have not been sent yet will be lost.
To reset the PIN, all data will be erased. In guest mode it is stored only on this device and cannot be recovered.
The data on this device has been erased
The encryption key of the data on this device is gone — for example, after the screen lock was reset or the system was restored. The saved data can no longer be read.
The unreadable data will be erased. Your data will be downloaded from the server again; changes that have not been sent yet will be lost.
The unreadable data will be erased. In guest mode it is stored only on this device and cannot be recovered.
The data file is encrypted, but its key is stored right next to it. Protects only against reading a single database file.
The key is kept in the Android secure storage. Files copied from the phone are useless without it. Background sync works.
The data opens only with the PIN or a fingerprint. No background sync; a forgotten PIN means erasing the data.
Come up with a new PIN
A fingerprint opens the data instead of the PIN
Blocks screenshots and hides the app in the recent apps list
The encryption key will lie next to the data. Anyone who copies the app files will be able to read them.
The data will open without the PIN and background sync will resume. The PIN stays as the app lock.
Protect the data with the PIN?

The data will open only with the PIN or a fingerprint.

• Background sync stops: data syncs only while the app is open.
• If you forget the PIN, the data will have to be erased and you will need to sign in again.
You are in guest mode: your data is stored only on this device, so with a forgotten PIN it will be lost for good.
PIN protection is not enabled: there is no background sync at that level, so unsent changes would get stuck. Connect to the internet and try again.
A fingerprint will open the data instead of the PIN. If the fingerprints on the device change, the PIN will still work.
Confirm to open the data with your fingerprint
Could not change the protection. Try again
First turn off data protection with the PIN
Could not turn on fingerprint unlock
